newsitem.title: USA: Union Acceptance stake upped by group.
newsitem.headline: Union Acceptance stake upped by group.

text.p: A group including Mercury Asset Management Plc, a London-based investment firm, said Wednesday it raised its stake in Union Acceptance Corp to 211,000 Class A common shares or 5.26 percent from 4.97 percent held previously.

In a filing with the Securities and Exchange Commission, the group said its latest transaction includes a net 50,500 Class A common bought between January 27 and March 21 at prices ranging from $14.4878 to $21.75 per share.
The group holds the stake in the Indianapolis, Ind.,-based personal credit institution for investment purposes.
Mercury is a wholly owned subsidiary of Mercury Asset Management Group Plc, a holding company.
